channel.title: ToS Watchdog — dliamkin.com
channel.description: Automated nightly monitoring of terms-of-service and policy documents. Entries describe detected changes in neutral, plain English. Not legal advice; not affiliated with any monitored service.

item.title: Google · Privacy Policy — change detected 2026-10-01
item.description: The only changes are removal of "Learn more" hyperlink text from two example paragraphs about Google Photos and Google Trends; the substantive descriptions of how data is used remain unchanged.

item.title: Anthropic · Privacy Policy — change detected 2026-09-12
item.description: Anthropic added a new Korea-specific PIPA addendum to its Privacy Policy detailing collection of identity-verification data, delegation of processing to third parties (Korea Credit Bureau, Kim & Chang), and overseas transfer of identity data to a US-based verification vendor (Persona), along with a user right to object to such transfers. The domestic representative in South Korea also changed from Bae, Kim & Lee LLC to Kim & Chang, with updated contact details." (6 changes detected by automated comparison — see the full entry for excerpts and details.)

item.title: UF Career Hub · Privacy Policy — change detected 2026-08-18
